How confidence is setIt follows the kind of evidence, not judgement.
  • The customer's own statement (high confidence at most): The organisation says so itself: its press release, website, annual report or a named executive on the record.
  • Regulatory or securities filing (high confidence at most): A filing by the customer or the vendor names the relationship.
  • Independent press (high confidence at most): Editorially independent reporting describes the deployment.
  • Joint announcement (medium confidence at most): A press release issued with the vendor, usually with a quote from the customer.
  • Vendor case study (medium confidence at most): The vendor's published customer story naming the organisation.
  • Vendor mention only (low confidence at most): A logo, a customer list or a passing mention by the vendor, with nothing from the customer.
  • An organisation that also holds a stake in the vendor is labelled “Investor and customer” and is never rated above medium.
  • A partnership is listed as a partner, not a customer.

Questions to ask the vendor (5)

  1. What was Redis's audited revenue for its most recent fiscal year, and is the company profitable or cash-flow positive?
    Audited revenue shows whether the vendor can fund the product; the company is private and publishes only a run-rate figure through the press.
  2. Which analyst evaluations of vector databases or data platforms has Redis been placed in during the last two years, and in what position?
    Analyst placements are one input to market presence.
  3. Has Redis or any affiliate been subject to any regulatory investigation, enforcement action or order in the last five years?
    Enforcement history is part of third-party due diligence.
  4. What litigation is Redis currently party to, and has any matter in the last five years concerned intellectual property, privacy or a customer contract?
    Material litigation can affect the vendor's finances and its right to supply the product.
  5. Have there been any departures of executive officers in the last 24 months, and for what reasons?
    Leadership instability can affect roadmap and support.

Timeline

  1. 2026-11-22 · launch Redis
    Redis Open Source 8.12 reaches general availability

    The Redis GitHub release page, dated 22 November, describes 8.12.0 as the general availability release of Redis 8.12 in Redis Open Source. The notes list compressed bitmaps, a lower-memory encoding for large sorted sets, set member expiration, and an opt-in SQ8 compression option for HNSW vector indexes. The notes list no CVE fixes; availability in Redis Cloud or Redis Software was not checked. Redis (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-22, opens in new tab)

  2. 2026-07-15 · layoff Redis
    Redis cuts about 200 roles globally

    Redis's chief executive stated in a post published on 2026-07-15 that the company was reducing approximately 200 roles globally, with research and development most affected, citing a move to smaller product and engineering teams. Reported by Globes on 2026-07-13: about 80 of 300 employees in Israel were to be laid off. Reported by CTech on 2026-07-13: about 70 employees in Israel were affected, out of about 1,300 worldwide. Redis (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-21, opens in new tab)Globes (independent press, retrieved 2026-11-21, opens in new tab)CTech by Calcalist (independent press, retrieved 2026-11-21, opens in new tab)

  3. 2025-10-09 · acquisition Redis
    Redis acquires feature store company Featureform

    Redis announced on 2025-10-09 that Featureform, a feature store company, was joining Redis to supply structured data to AI agents. No price was given. Redis (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-21, opens in new tab)

  4. 2025-10-03 · vulnerability disclosure Redis
    Redis discloses critical Lua scripting flaw CVE-2025-49844

    Redis disclosed on 2025-10-03 a use-after-free flaw in Lua scripting, rated CVSS 10.0, that could let an authenticated user run code on the host; it affected all Redis Software releases and all open source releases with Lua scripting. Redis stated that at-risk Redis Cloud subscriptions had been patched and that it had no evidence of exploitation. Wiz, which found the flaw, reported on 2025-10-06 that it had been present for about 13 years. Redis (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-21, opens in new tab)Wiz (other, retrieved 2026-11-21, opens in new tab)

  5. 2025-09-04 · acquisition Redis
    Redis announces intent to acquire Decodable

    Redis announced on 2025-09-04 that it intended to acquire Decodable, a streaming data pipeline platform, to extend its data integration product. The post gave no price and did not say the deal had closed. Redis (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-21, opens in new tab)

  6. 2025-05-01 · launch Redis
    Redis 8 released with AGPLv3 licence option and vector sets

    Redis announced on 2025-05-01 that Redis 8 was available, adding the OSI-approved AGPLv3 as a third licence option alongside RSALv2 and SSPLv1, merging the search engine, JSON, time series and probabilistic types into the core, and introducing the vector set data type, labelled preview in the 8.0 release notes.
